site_tagline: Interactive planners for big Minecraft modpacks
footer_disclaimer: Fan-made site, not affiliated with the All the Mods team, Mojang or the mod authors. Data comes from the mods' and modpack's own files.
home_lead: Bee breeding trees, quests and crafting chains, extracted straight from the game files and kept up to date with each pack release. Open it on your second screen.
home_why_1: Read from the files, not from memory: every tree and recipe comes from the mods' data.
home_why_2: Updated with the pack: a script re-reads each new version.
home_why_3: Your progress stays in your browser, no account needed.
tool_bees_desc: Every Productive Bees bee, its breeding tree, tiers and how to get it. Tick what you have to see what's unlocked.
tool_quests_desc: All the pack's quests with search, filters and a "done" checkbox.
tool_howto_desc: Type an item and see the whole chain to make it, with the pack's modified recipes.
bees_meta: Interactive Productive Bees breeding tree for {pack}: {n} bees, tiers, nests, conversions and progress tracking.

js.foot: Hover a slot to see what it needs, click for details and to tick it. Drag to move around. Tier = number of steps from a wild bee. Data: Productive Bees 1.21.1, Productive Metalworks and ATM10 recipes. Your progress is saved in this browser.
js.state_lock: Locked: you're missing a parent bee
js.toast_nothing: Nothing new yet, it'll be useful later.
js.k_conversion: Conversion: right-click the bee with the item
js.k_item_conversion: The bee transforms an item in its hive
